title: DLR Institute of Materials Research
content:
The DLR Institute of Materials Research, part of the German Aerospace Center (DLR) in Cologne, hosts the Department of Aerogels and Highly Porous Materials led by Prof. Barbara Milow. The team develops organic and inorganic aerogels, including silica, mixed-oxide, carbon, and bio-polymer-based systems, from laboratory scale through pilot plant to prototype, with service temperatures from about -200 °C to +1400 °C.

Applications include thermal protection systems for spacecraft, cryogenic tank insulation for LH2, LOX, and LNG, lightweight and acoustic insulation for vehicles, and electrochemical components. DLR coordinated the Horizon 2020 ISBA project on European aerogel solutions for space with partners such as ArianeGroup, Thales Alenia Space, Hutchinson, and KEEY Aerogel, and offers application-oriented testing support for industry.
